status: fixed before any five-day target fits; exploratory development study after V1 final and earlier V2 results were viewed
reason: Test whether a one-week REIT price change has usable signal when next-day return does not
target: log(SRT_close[t+5] / SRT_close[t]) on five consecutive SRT trading rows
boundary: discard evaluation windows whose five-day label ends after development_cutoff; training labels must end strictly before first evaluation forecast date; repeat purge for inner stopping
features: original 20x6 saved V1 inputs, no new indicators
alpha_selection: inner-stop raw five-day return RMSE; larger alpha on exact tie; full outer training refit
advance_rule: Ridge must improve pooled RMSE by at least 1% against the strongest pooled baseline, improve over it in at least two folds, and have pooled MAE no more than 1% worse; only then consider matched LSTM/fuzzy training
interpretation: five-day errors are not comparable numerically to one-day errors; overlapping labels reduce effective independent observations; no final_holdout data can enter evaluation or model selection
